scripts.dev: npm run build -w @xomdao/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @xomdao/shared" "npm run dev -w @xomdao/server" "node scripts/web.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @xomdao/shared && npm run build -w @xomdao/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @xomdao/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @xomdao/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node scripts/gen-protocol.mjs --check && npm run test && node tools/godot/check.mjs --if-installed
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @xomdao/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @xomdao/shared" "npm run dev -w @xomdao/server"
